proposal.summary: CSRF in Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin <=1.1 allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials and retrieve test IDs and names when a valid credential corresponds to the attacker-specified username.
proposal.affected_product: Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier
proposal.cwe_quote: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials, and to retrieve test IDs and names from Frugal Testing, if a valid credential corresponds to the attacker-specified username.

AV.quote: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials

PR.quote: allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials

C.quote: retrieve test IDs and names from Frugal Testing

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm reproducibility and the required victim privileges; identify required Jenkins user roles and whether credentials must belong to the victim. Develop and test a CSRF protection patch (require valid crumb/token) and coordinate disclosure with plugin maintainers.
